scope: The exact retained standalone TLS relay only; no general claim that the component has no other defects
source_role: Reads stdin and writes the bytes through SSL_write; reads SSL_read and copies bytes to stdout. Arguments select a socket FD, SNI, and verification mode; it does not parse a URL or serialize an HTTP request-target/Host.
affected_writer: The BusyBox wget HTTP target/Host writer is in the separately measured patched /bin/busybox; binsh shares that exact common dispatcher payload.
